text: Everybody is a genius. But if you judge a fish by its ability to climb a tree, it will live its whole life believing that it is stupid.
author: Albert Einstein

text: If I have seen further than others, it is by standing upon the shoulders of giants.
author: Isaac Newton

text: Excellence is never an accident. It is always the result of high intention, sincere effort, and intelligent execution; it represents the wise choice of many alternatives - choice, not chance, determines your destiny.
author: Aristotle

text: The more you know, the more you know you don't know.
author: Aristotle

text: We are what we repeatedly do.
author: Aristotle

text: Courage is the first virtue that makes all other virtues possible.
author: Aristotle

text: It is the mark of an educated mind to be able to entertain a thought without accepting it.
author: Aristotle

text: Happiness is a quality of the soul...not a function of one's material circumstances.
author: Aristotle

text: Rules for Happiness: something to do, someone to love, something to hope for.
author: Immanuel Kant

text: Patience is the strength of the weak, impatience is the weakness of the strong.
author: Immanuel Kant
